summary: Assess offtaker risk, tariffs, bankability, and negotiation issues in IPP PPAs. Explore the course and build practical transaction skills.
lede: Power purchase agreement (PPA) commercial structuring helps project teams assess the terms, risks, and revenue assumptions behind independent power projects. For utility commercial teams, developers, financiers, regulators, and transaction advisers, the training develops practical skills in mapping offtaker and payment risks, comparing tariff structures, and testing cash-flow sensitivities. Participants also prepare negotiation priorities and transaction action plans, while advanced financing structures receive overview-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who develop, review, finance, regulate, or negotiate independent power projects and their PPAs. It suits intermediate learners who need practical tools for assessing commercial terms and transaction risks.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with power-sector projects, commercial contracts, infrastructure finance, or public-sector project review is recommended. No programming is required. You should be ready to work with basic project and tariff assumptions in a spreadsheet; advanced project-finance modelling is outside the course scope.
